'''Bookies''' were individuals who manage bets. [[Jokol]] was a bookie on [[The Wheel/Legends|The Wheel]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]]. [[Plummet bookie]]s worked on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].
